title: aster ramulosus var. incanopilosus
intro: Aster ramulosus var. incanopilosus, commonly known as the Himalayan aster or Indian daisy, is a plant species that belongs to the daisy family (Asteraceae) and is native to the Himalayan region. The plant is used in traditional medicine and is known for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to treat various health conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and skin infections. The therapeutic actions of Aster ramulosus var. incanopilosus include its ability to reduce inflammation, kill bacteria, and scavenge free radicals, making it a valuable herb in the treatment of various diseases. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
